root_cause.text: The error path in sev_tsm_init_locked() attempts to dereference a pointer to structure 't' in a pr_err() call after the memory has already been freed with kfree(), resulting in a use-after-free condition.
root_cause.evidence: The patch shows that kfree(t) was originally placed before the pr_err() statement that accesses t->tio_en and t->tio_init_done. The fix reorders these operations by moving the pr_err() call before kfree(t), ensuring the structure fields are accessed while the memory is still valid. The diff clearly shows the two lines being swapped in the error_exit label of drivers/crypto/ccp/sev-dev-tsm.c at line 378-382.

intent_record.what: Moved the kfree(t) call from before the pr_err() statement to after it in the error_exit label of sev_tsm_init_locked().
